variants.name: Mounts だけを出す・止めてから消す

where: podman exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c 'SHOW data_directory'
mount: podman stop db && podman rm db
podman exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c 'SELECT * FROM reservations'
podman exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c "INSERT INTO reservations VALUES (4, '市民ホール')"
recreate: podman exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM reservations'

where: podman exec db psql -U postgres -c 'SHOW data_directory;'
mount: podman exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c "INSERT INTO reservations VALUES (4, '市民ホール')"
recreate: podman exec db psql -U postgres -d reserve -c 'SELECT count(*) FROM reservations;'
